objective: Isolate ordinary incumbent lifetime and connection scheduling as potential contributors to native quality gaps; keep original research gates.

modes.0_bulk_wave: Existing behavior:remove every pending ordinary net before the first wave,refresh owners once,then connection waves with issue width4.
modes.1_dispatch_wave: Retain each pending incumbent until immediately before the batch containing its first connection. Rip up first-dispatched nets in that batch,refresh owners once,then generate fresh seeds and execute the same connection-wave batches. Later connections reuse the newly built partial tree.
modes.2_serial_net: Retain incumbents until each net is selected in the existing net order. Rip up that net immediately before its first connection,then complete all its connections one at a time before moving to the next pending net. Effective issue width1 is explicit.

invariants: Mode0 preserves all existing common output artifacts/counters/native QoR; new metadata and ripup sidecars are explicit additions.
Each pending ordinary net is reset exactly once per noninitial epoch. First epoch has no incumbent ripups.
Ripup removes only that net from owner membership; other incumbents and already-published branches survive. Refresh once per bulk/first-dispatch group before search.

Seeds are generated after any required ripup,never from an unremoved old tree. Within a connection wave each net appears at most once,so moving seed construction to actual dispatch must preserve mode0 seeds.
Every connection of each pending net is attempted once; failure bookkeeping and shared-node occupancy remain exact.
Source net ordering remains unchanged:initial input priority,then leading connection criticality/priority/id. This is not a VPR fanout-order replication.
No legal-subtree pruning or alternate congestion schedule is introduced. Deferred and serial modes reject unsupported feedback/private-trial/edge/worker/cleanup combinations.
trace: Add deterministic ordinary_ripups CSV:iteration,net_id,dispatch_batch,phase,tree_nodes_before,routed_connections_before. Phase0 bulk records share one pre-first-batch refresh; phases1/2 record first-dispatch refresh groups. Record effective issue width in existing epoch audit. No wall time in deterministic trace.
validation: Boundary fixtures for first epoch,once/net ripup,retained unrelated incumbents,shared nodes,failed first connection and fresh seeds.
Complete backend/controller ASan/UBSan; mode0 five-repeat parent compatibility.
Independent logical paths/pending/ripup schedule and resource-version history replay supporting effective issue width1.
Five-repeat native legality/determinism and full matched-source/config/environment three-arm comparison; refreshed-hash corrupt-fixture checks.
acceptance: Original joint native WL/CPD/SLL and no-extra-failure gates unchanged. CPU serialization is an accuracy diagnostic,not an acceleration or physical throughput claim.
limitations: Current local VPR code/log differences motivate controls,not causal attribution or exact VPR equivalence. Its complete original as-built source identity is unverified. No new heldout tuning,clock reduction,hardware execution or novelty claim.
